key_insight: PANDA-D infers both advancing and receding dynamic contact angles directly from density and center-of-mass profiles, avoiding explicit interface extraction.
engineering_relevance: This enables more reproducible, automated wetting analysis in molecular simulations where contour-based angle estimation can be threshold-sensitive and ambiguous.
method: Fits a circular-meniscus model to the liquid roll using two observables: density profile and layerwise center-of-mass displacement.
Disambiguates which meniscus is advancing by jointly constraining both profiles.
Returns receding angle, advancing angle, and an effective near-wall offset without contour tracing.
evidence_signal: On synthetic rolls, the method achieved 0.29° RMS reconstruction error, and on Lennard-Jones rolls it matched independent circle-fit angles within 0.84° RMS.
watch_item: Accuracy depends on the validity of the circular-meniscus assumption and the quality of the layerwise density/displacement profiles, especially near the wall.
paper_title: PANDA-D: Interface-free determination of two dynamic contact angles
